description: Supports Deezer 9.0.27.3, restores protected startup and native components, and fixes first-login Home loading.

patches.name: Block ads
patches.description: Hides banner and native ads and skips visual pre-rolls and audio ad breaks.

patches.name: Choose tracks on demand
patches.description: Select tracks in albums, playlists, artist pages, profiles, and Deezer recommendations. Play albums in order and shuffle playlists from their header.

patches.name: Enable offline downloads
patches.description: Unlocks the OFFLINE entitlement and download actions in menus (subject to server-side stream availability).

patches.name: Enable player navigation
patches.description: Enables unlimited track skips, previous and next controls, and seeking within a track.

patches.name: Hide Premium offers
patches.description: Hides offer pop-ups, the Premium tab and upgrade buttons, and locked audio quality options.

patches.name: Manage the playback queue
patches.description: Opens the queue and adds Add to queue and Play Next to supported menus.

patches.name: Open lyrics from the player
patches.description: Opens Deezer's lyrics view instead of the Premium prompt when a lyrics button is tapped.

patches.name: Search and sort playlists
patches.description: Adds the native search shortcut to playlist headers and Sort to playlist menus.

release_notes:
Supports Deezer Android **9.0.27.3**.

- Updated all 8 patches for Deezer 9.0.27.3.
- Restored protected startup, native components, and startup compatibility.
- Fixed first-login Home loading.

All eight patches were tested together on an Android 14 emulator. Refresh the Deezer source in Morphe Manager to get the bundle.
